verdict.rationale: Gazebo exposes official C++ libraries (gz-math, gz-transport, sdformat) and a documented plugin API for developers to build custom applications/plugins on top of the simulator, satisfying a generic 'official SDK' story. However, there is no evidence of any AI-native or agent-specific SDK, language bindings beyond C++, or tooling tailored to autonomous/agentic workflows. Missing for 10: AI/agent-specific SDK or client library, non-C++ language bindings (e.g. Python agent APIs), and any documentation framing SDK use for autonomous agent integration.
